chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, sent down the House from the heaven, and it had four doors. On each door, there was a lantern of gold hanging.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ: four doors belonging to the House
key_terms.ٱلسَّمَاءِ: the heaven from which the House was sent down
key_terms.ٱلْبَيْتَ: the House, referring to the sacred Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the heavenly origin and description of the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, sent down the House from the heaven. It describes the House as having four doors, with a hanging golden lantern on each door, indicating its exalted and sacred nature.
